title: 美股盘前：盈利动能托底，AI链进入优胜劣汰
summary: 期指小幅走高，伊朗/霍尔木兹缓和与强财报托底；AI链内部从普涨转向业绩和订单验证，AMD/SPCX负反馈压制芯片情绪，ANET/SHOP/DIS/LLY等强反馈支撑风险偏好。

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
宏观
美股期指盘前小幅走高，纪录高位附近继续消化盈利季
道指、标普和纳指期指均为正，市场把昨日大涨后的追高冲动和个股财报分化同时定价。
地缘
伊朗与霍尔木兹局势出现缓和预期，但油价反弹提醒风险未完全解除
Brent 回到约 80 美元附近，说明能源风险溢价下降后仍会被外交进展和航运安全反复拉扯。
财报
AMD (AMD) 业绩 beat 但盘前跌约 8%-9%
市场惩罚点在毛利率/指引弹性不足，以及 SpaceX 转向 Nvidia 芯片的需求叙事冲击；不得按利好追多处理。
科技
SpaceX (SPCX) 首份上市后财报收入强劲但盘前跌约 10%-12%
资本开支高、亏损和锁定期压力压过收入增长，AI 基建叙事短线转为现金流约束。
财报
Arista Networks (ANET) 财报和全年收入展望获正反馈
盘前涨幅约 10% 上下，AI 云网络订单仍是今天科技股里最清晰的强势线索。
财报
Shopify (SHOP) 盘前大涨约 25%-28%
收入和盈利韧性好于预期，电商软件重新获得估值扩张窗口，但跳空后需要成交承接确认。
财报
Disney (DIS)、CVS (CVS)、Eli Lilly (LLY) 财报正反馈支撑非科技权重
DIS 盘前约 +3% 至 +4%，LLY 约 +5%，CVS 约 +2% 至 +3%，大盘不完全依赖半导体上行。
财报
Uber (UBER) 盈利 beat 但盘前跌约 4%
收入/指引不够强，机器人出租车合作利好被短线兑现压力覆盖，偏观察而非追涨。
科技
Nvidia (NVDA) 受 SpaceX 芯片选择消息支撑，盘前相对强于 AMD
AI GPU 需求份额叙事继续向龙头集中，芯片链内部出现“赢家更强、二线承压”的轮动。
盘后
今晚盘后科技财报集中在存储、广告软件、自动化与中小型软件
Sandisk (SNDK)、Western Digital (WDC)、AppLovin (APP)、Motorola Solutions (MSI)、Symbotic (SYM)、SiTime (SITM)、IonQ (IONQ) 是可验证样本。

盘前结论

今天的事实底色是“指数偏强、个股分化”：期指继续上行，伊朗/霍尔木兹缓和预期和盈利季 beat 率托住风险偏好；但 AMD、SPCX、UBER 的盘前负反馈说明市场不再单纯奖励收入增长，而是更看重利润率、现金流、指引弹性和订单质量。

开盘后大盘更可能先高开震荡，标普和道指相对稳，纳指需要看 NVDA、ANET、SHOP 能否抵消 AMD/SPCX 对 AI 基建链的拖累。若 10Y 继续回落并且油价不过快上冲，资金会优先买入“业绩确认 + 盘前强反馈”的软件、电商平台、云网络和医疗权重。

不确定性在于高位拥挤。昨天科技大涨后，任何盘前利好但股价转弱的公司都应降级观察；今天更适合跟随价格确认，而不是提前押注叙事修复。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

Arista Networks
ANET
强势跟踪

推荐理由：财报和收入展望获得盘前约 10% 正反馈，AI 云网络需求比泛芯片叙事更可验证。

触发因素：开盘后若放量站稳盘前高位且强于 Nasdaq/SMH，可确认资金切向网络设备。

风险点：高开过大后若跌回盘前涨幅一半以下，说明估值兑现压力上升。

Shopify
SHOP
动量观察

推荐理由：盘前涨约 25%-28%，软件和电商基础设施中价格反馈最强，且不受 AMD/SPCX 负反馈直接拖累。

触发因素：首小时成交维持高位、回踩不破 VWAP，可延续软件修复交易。

风险点：跳空幅度过大，若开盘快速回补缺口，不追高。

Nvidia
NVDA
龙头确认

推荐理由：SpaceX 芯片选择消息强化 GPU 龙头份额叙事，盘前相对 AMD 明显占优。

触发因素：若 NVDA 强于 SOXX 且 AMD 不能修复，资金会继续向 AI 龙头集中。

风险点：AI 链昨天涨幅较大，若 10Y 上行或 ANET 回落，NVDA 也可能被动降温。

Walt Disney
DIS
权重托底

推荐理由：财报后盘前约 +3% 至 +4%，内容和乐园业务正反馈有助于道指/消费服务托底。

触发因素：若开盘后维持强于 XLC/XLY，可作为科技分化时的防守型进攻标的。

风险点：若管理层指引未能支撑全年利润率，盘中可能回吐财报涨幅。

Eli Lilly
LLY
医疗强势

推荐理由：EPS/收入明显 beat 并上调全年展望，盘前约 +5%，提供非科技权重支撑。

触发因素：若开盘后医疗板块广度改善，LLY 可对冲纳指高位震荡风险。

风险点：估值较高，若减肥药销售细节低于买方预期，追高空间会受限。

板块轮动看板

强势观察云网络、软件电商、医疗权重、部分内容消费；代表 ANET、SHOP、LLY、DIS。
事件驱动NVDA 因 SpaceX 芯片选择获得相对优势；APP/SNDK/WDC 今晚盘后会验证广告软件与 AI 存储。
压力方向AMD、SPCX、UBER 均是“结果不差但股价被卖”的负反馈，芯片二线和高 CAPEX 科技避免追多。
验证信号看 10Y 是否守在 4.61% 附近下方、WTI 是否不过快突破 77、ANET/SHOP 首小时能否守住 VWAP。

逻辑链

盈利季 beat 率高 -> 指数高开有支撑
盘前价格分化 -> 资金从泛 AI 转向订单确认
利率和油价未失控 -> 高估值科技仍可选择性上行
若 AMD/SPCX 继续下探 -> 纳指冲高回落概率上升

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为判断，不是事实；依据为已知一致预期、历史 surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气，并结合今天盘前市场对相邻公司的价格反馈。

偏高概率：Western Digital (WDC)、AppLovin (APP)。WDC 受 AI 存储需求、价格上涨和供应偏紧支撑，市场预期为 EPS 约 3.33、收入约 37 亿美元；APP 历史连续 beat、广告技术收入韧性和 Q1 surprise 提供基础，但估值已高。
中等概率：Sandisk (SNDK)、Motorola Solutions (MSI)、Symbotic (SYM)。SNDK 受 AI 存储景气支撑但今年涨幅极大，beat 后也可能被卖；MSI 公共安全软件/设备需求稳定；SYM 自动化订单强但项目节奏可能影响利润率。
低到中等概率：SiTime (SITM)、IonQ (IONQ)、Fastly (FSLY)。SITM/IONQ 主题弹性高但预期和估值敏感；FSLY 需要收入加速和亏损收窄同时兑现，容错率较低。

已检查 Digrin 2026-08-05 AMC 日历、Western Digital IR、AppLovin IR、Investopedia、MarketWatch/Barron's/IBD 实时盘前报道；样本包含明确公司名称和 ticker。

风险雷达

AMD/SPCX 负反馈扩散若两者开盘继续下探，AI 基建链会从盈利兑现转向去杠杆。
高位指数获利了结标普和道指接近纪录区域，财报强势股若冲高回落会压缩风险偏好。
油价二次上冲WTI 若快速突破 77-78，通胀和长端利率压力会重新定价。
盘后存储财报反向验证SNDK/WDC 若只 beat 不上调或利润率不够强，AI 存储链可能复制 AMD 的负反馈。

数据来源与时间点

抓取时间：2026-08-05 21:03 CST；来源：AP、Investopedia、MarketWatch、Barron's、IBD、Digrin earnings calendar、Western Digital IR、AppLovin IR；盘前价格以公开盘前报道约数为准。
entries.html_en:
Major News
Macro
US futures edge higher as earnings season is absorbed near record levels
Dow, S&P and Nasdaq futures were all positive, with the market pricing both the urge to chase the prior session's rally and sharp company-level earnings dispersion.
Geopolitics
Iran and Hormuz de-escalation hopes improve, but the oil rebound shows risk has not disappeared
Brent returned to around $80, indicating that the energy risk premium remains sensitive to diplomacy and shipping security even after easing from conflict highs.
Earnings
AMD beats earnings expectations but falls about 8%-9% premarket
The market focused on insufficient gross-margin and guidance upside as well as the demand narrative around SpaceX choosing Nvidia chips. The positive headline does not justify chasing the stock.
Tech
SpaceX posts strong revenue in its first public earnings report but falls about 10%-12% premarket
High capital expenditure, losses and lockup pressure outweighed revenue growth, shifting the AI-infrastructure narrative toward cash-flow constraints.
Earnings
Arista Networks receives a positive response to earnings and its full-year revenue outlook
The stock rose roughly 10% premarket, making AI cloud-network orders one of the clearest positive technology signals of the session.
Earnings
Shopify jumps about 25%-28% premarket
Revenue and earnings resilience exceeded expectations, reopening a valuation-expansion window for ecommerce software, although such a large gap still needs volume support after the open.
Earnings
Positive reports from Disney, CVS and Eli Lilly support non-tech index weights
DIS was up about 3%-4% premarket, LLY about 5%, and CVS about 2%-3%, reducing the market's dependence on semiconductor strength.
Earnings
Uber beats on profit but falls about 4% premarket
Revenue and guidance were not strong enough to attract buyers, while enthusiasm around robotaxi partnerships was overtaken by profit-taking. The stock belongs on watch rather than in a chase.
Tech
Nvidia benefits from the SpaceX chip-selection report and outperforms AMD premarket
The AI GPU share narrative continues to concentrate in the leader, creating a winner-takes-more split between Nvidia and second-tier chip exposure.
After hours
Tonight's technology earnings span storage, advertising software, automation and smaller software names
Verifiable samples include Sandisk (SNDK), Western Digital (WDC), AppLovin (APP), Motorola Solutions (MSI), Symbotic (SYM), SiTime (SITM) and IonQ (IONQ).

Premarket Takeaway

The factual backdrop is stronger indexes but sharp stock-level dispersion. Futures are higher, while Hormuz de-escalation expectations and a solid earnings-season beat rate support risk appetite. However, negative premarket reactions in AMD, SPCX and UBER show that the market now demands margin quality, cash flow and guidance upside, not just revenue growth.

The likely open is higher but choppy. S&P and Dow should be relatively stable, while Nasdaq depends on whether NVDA, ANET and SHOP can offset pressure from AMD and SPCX across AI infrastructure. If the 10Y yield keeps easing and oil does not surge, flows should favor software, ecommerce platforms, cloud networking and healthcare weights with confirmed earnings and strong price reactions.

The key uncertainty is crowding near market highs. After the prior technology rally, any company with positive news but a weakening premarket price should be downgraded to watch status. Following confirmed price action is preferable to front-running a narrative recovery.

Stock Watchlist

Arista Networks
ANET
Strength watch

Why:Earnings and the revenue outlook drew a roughly 10% positive premarket response, making AI cloud-network demand more verifiable than a broad chip narrative.

Trigger:The stock holds near its premarket high on strong volume and outperforms Nasdaq and SMH after the open.

Risk:A drop below half of the premarket gain would signal rising valuation and profit-taking pressure.

Shopify
SHOP
Momentum watch

Why:The 25%-28% premarket gain is the strongest price response in software and ecommerce infrastructure and is not directly exposed to the AMD/SPCX backlash.

Trigger:First-hour volume remains elevated and a pullback holds VWAP.

Risk:The opening gap is very large; do not chase if the stock quickly fills it.

Nvidia
NVDA
Leader check

Why:The SpaceX chip-selection report reinforces the GPU leader's share narrative, and NVDA is clearly stronger than AMD premarket.

Trigger:NVDA outperforms SOXX while AMD fails to recover, confirming continued concentration in the AI leader.

Risk:The AI chain rallied in the prior session; higher Treasury yields or an ANET reversal could cool NVDA as well.

Walt Disney
DIS
Index support

Why:The 3%-4% premarket earnings gain in content and parks helps support Dow and consumer-services exposure.

Trigger:The stock remains stronger than XLC and XLY after the open.

Risk:The earnings gain could fade if management's outlook does not support full-year margins.

Eli Lilly
LLY
Healthcare strength

Why:EPS and revenue beat clearly, the full-year outlook rose, and the stock gained about 5% premarket, supporting non-tech index weights.

Trigger:Healthcare breadth improves after the open, allowing LLY to offset Nasdaq volatility.

Risk:Valuation is elevated; weaker-than-buy-side obesity-drug details would limit upside after the gap.

Rotation Board

Strength WatchCloud networking, ecommerce software, healthcare weights and selected content names represented by ANET, SHOP, LLY and DIS.
Event DrivenNVDA gains relative advantage from the SpaceX chip-selection report; APP, SNDK and WDC test advertising software and AI storage after hours.
PressureAMD, SPCX and UBER all show negative price reactions despite acceptable results. Avoid chasing second-tier chips and high-capex technology.
ConfirmWatch whether the 10Y stays below the 4.61% area, WTI avoids a rapid break above 77, and ANET and SHOP hold VWAP in the first hour.

Logic Chain

A high earnings-season beat rate supports a higher index open
Divergent premarket reactions redirect flows from broad AI exposure toward confirmed orders
Contained rates and oil allow selective upside in high-valuation technology
Further weakness in AMD and SPCX raises the probability of a Nasdaq fade after strength

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

The following is judgment, not fact. It is based on known consensus expectations, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions, industry conditions and today's price reactions in adjacent companies.

Higher probability: Western Digital (WDC) and AppLovin (APP). WDC is supported by AI-storage demand, higher pricing and tight supply, with consensus near EPS of 3.33 and revenue around $3.7 billion. APP has a history of beats, resilient advertising-technology revenue and a positive first-quarter surprise, although valuation is already high.
Medium probability: Sandisk (SNDK), Motorola Solutions (MSI) and Symbotic (SYM). SNDK benefits from AI-storage conditions but has rallied sharply and could still sell off after a beat. MSI has stable public-safety software and equipment demand. SYM has strong automation orders but project timing can affect margins.
Low-to-medium probability: SiTime (SITM), IonQ (IONQ) and Fastly (FSLY). SITM and IONQ have high thematic sensitivity and demanding expectations. FSLY needs both faster revenue growth and narrower losses, leaving little room for error.

Calendars and sources checked: Digrin August 5 after-market-close calendar, Western Digital IR, AppLovin IR, Investopedia, MarketWatch, Barron's and IBD premarket reporting. The sample includes explicit company names and tickers.

Risk Radar

AMD and SPCX backlash spreadsIf both extend losses after the open, AI infrastructure can shift from earnings realization to deleveraging.
Profit-taking near index highsS&P and Dow are near record territory; reversals in strong earnings stocks would compress risk appetite.
Second oil spikeA quick WTI break above 77-78 would reprice inflation and long-end yield pressure.
Storage earnings reject the narrativeIf SNDK and WDC only beat without raising guidance or showing sufficient margins, AI storage could repeat AMD's negative reaction.

Sources And Timestamp
